html:
Al-Shabaab is a jihadist group that grew out of the youth wing of the Islamic Courts Union in Somalia and has fought the Somali government since the Ethiopian invasion of 2006.

It held Mogadishu and much of the south until African Union troops drove it from the capital in 2011, and still controls large rural areas where it collects taxes and runs courts. It joined al-Qaeda in 2012.

It has carried out attacks in Kenya, including the Westgate shopping mall in Nairobi in 2013 and Garissa University in 2015, and in Uganda. A truck bomb in Mogadishu in October 2017 killed more than 500 people. Its war has kept the civil war going and drawn in Kenya and Ethiopia.
sum: Al-Shabaab is a jihadist group that grew out of the youth wing of the Islamic Courts Union in Somalia and has fought the Somali government since the Ethiopian invasion of 2006.
